profile_description: Severin is a German quality brand that has been delivering innovative, intuitive, and sustainable household solutions for more than 130 years. Its mission: Premium for Everyone. Severin creates high-quality products that stand out worldwide for their design, functionality, and reliability. The brand combines technical excellence with a modern lifestyle, developing products that not only make everyday life easier but also enrich it. Severin is more than technology. It is a brand that keeps moving forward and continuously creates new possibilities. Headquartered in Sundern, Germany, with a strong international network, five wholly owned sales subsidiaries across Europe, and a long-standing presence in Asia, Severin reinforces its position as a trusted partner. The company creates not only outstanding technology but also lasting experiences. For generations, Severin has remained committed to reliable quality, premium products, exceptional service, and sustainability. For Severin, premium does not mean luxury reserved for a select few. It means a lifestyle that is accessible to everyone, inspires people, and exceeds expectations.

Innovation, tradition, quality and design A fully automatic coffee machine from JURA – always the right choice Fully automatic coffee machines from JURA are associated with the best coffee quality, easy operation and stunning design. Enjoy a wide range of coffee specialties at the touch of a button with JURA – always freshly ground, not capsuled. The JURA brand has stood for the highest quality, pioneering innovation, first-class design and sustainability in practice since 1931.

Taking care of the beauty and hygiene of both clothes and homes is what we have been doing as a Swiss family business for over 40 years. We are Laurastar and our mission is to make life more beautiful and homes healthier. Today, we are the world's leading manufacturer of high-quality steam systems, and the creators of a unique technology: Laurastar Dry Microfine Steam (DMS). From ironing to disinfecting fabrics, objects and surfaces, we are committed to fighting against planned obsolescence with sustainable and repairable products designed to beautify and purify clothes and homes for a generation.

At Kärcher, a team of 17,000 people in 87 countries and more than 170 companies is working together to make the world a cleaner place. As a family company with a focus on sustainability, we firmly believe that the important things in life need extra care to ensure they stand the test of time and preserve their value in future, too. This applies to our own home just as much as it does to our environment, our community, our workplace, our historical heritage or our tradition. Kärcher provides solutions for all areas of cleaning and maintenance all over the world. From the everyday to the extraordinary. Whether it's our products or our services. As a comprehensive package for professional users, an indispensable must-have for every household or a customised digital solution for individual clients. Unsolved cleaning problems are our daily motivation to keep on innovating. Because real innovations are those that benefit people and the environment. In 1935, when Alfred Kärcher established his company, he laid the foundation for our success. Today, Kärcher is the world market leader in cleaning technology and a major global company with a turnover of 3.483 billion euros in 2025. Nevertheless, our headquarters are still in Winnenden, Germany, where the company has its strong roots. Find out more about Kärcher: https://www.kaercher.com/int/inside-kaercher/company/about-kaercher.html

Wir sind AEG. Wir definieren neu, was Sie von Ihren Hausgeräten erwarten können. Deshalb hinterfragen wir die Grenzen des Alltags immer wieder. Seit unseren Anfängen 1887 in Berlin haben wir uns nie mit gut genug zufriedengegeben. Wir setzen auf verantwortungsbewusste Innovationen, die sich heute abheben und dabei helfen, eine bessere Zukunft zu gestalten. AEG ist Teil der Electrolux Group, einem weltweit führenden Hausgerätehersteller, der seine Produkte in 120 Märkten verkauft. Die Electrolux Group erzielte 2023 einen Gesamtumsatz von 134 Milliarden SEK (circa 11,8 Mrd. EUR) und beschäftigte weltweit 45.000 Menschen. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter aeg.de

Hisense, founded in 1969, is a globally recognized leader in home appliances and consumer electronics with operations in over 160 countries, specializing in delivering high-quality multimedia products, home appliances, and intelligent IT solutions. According to Omdia, Hisense ranks No. 2 worldwide in total TV volume shipments (2022-2024) and No. 1 globally in the 100-inch and over TV segment (2023- 2024). As the first official partner of the FIFA Club World Cup 2025™, Hisense is committed to global sports partnerships as a way to connect with audiences worldwide.

TCL is a leading global tech brand in display panels, TVs, home comfort and mobile devices. Founded in 1981, TCL operates its manufacturing and R&D centers worldwide and has products and services in 160+ countries. At TCL, we are dedicated to improving people's lives and experiences with our innovative technology. Our products and services aim to solve problems, bring joy to families and friends, and create a safer and healthier world. We aspire to inspire and empower people to pursue greatness in their lives.

About the Panasonic Group Founded in 1918, and today a global leader in developing innovative technologies and solutions for wide-ranging applications in the consumer electronics, housing, devices, B2B solutions and energy sectors worldwide, the Panasonic Group switched to an operating company system on April 1, 2022 with Panasonic Holdings Corporation serving as a holding company. The Group reported consolidated net sales of Euro 51.6 billion (8,458.2 billion yen) for the year ended March 31, 2025. To learn more about the Panasonic Group, please visit: https://holdings.panasonic/global/

Innovating home comfort since 1933. We specialize in high-quality appliances that blend cutting-edge technology with timeless design. From vacuum cleaners to air purifiers, our products are crafted to enhance your living experience. Discover excellence in every detail with Fakir–your trusted partner for a smarter, cleaner home.

Anker Innovations' mission is to ignite possibilities through ultimate innovation. We believe the essence of creating products lies in transforming users' basic needs. To fulfill this mission, our charging brand Anker pioneered PowerIQ™ technology for universal fast-charging compatibility, introduced gallium nitride (GaN) to consumer electronics, and ushered in the era of fast charging. We also established the Balcony Solar Storage Business, enabling households and businesses to utilize renewable energy more efficiently. Our smart home brand eufy introduced HomeBase Local Base Station Storage and SolarPlus™ technology for forever solar-powered operation, significantly enhancing the safety and reliability of home security. Meanwhile, our audio and video brand soundcore developed the ACAA™ Astria Coaxial Acoustic Architecture, delivering symphony-level sound quality in true wireless earbuds. Since our founding in 2011, we have consistently created technology products loved by consumers worldwide. We take pride in looking beyond the surface, seeking the essence, and using ultimate innovation to bring the next generation of visionary products to the world.
Über 1.100 Elektro-Fachhändler vertrauen uns. Wir sind die Kooperation der Technik-Profis.

SBS, an international leader in the smartphone and tablet accessories sector, is renowned for its ability to meet the diverse demands of the ever-evolving consumer electronics market. Its products transcend mere functionality, embodying a commitment to innovative design and services. SBS not only prioritizes its business approach but also embraces a consumer-oriented philosophy, ensuring a satisfying and forward-looking experience for the end customer at the point of sale. SBS, always projected into the future of technology, design, and services, is synonymous with continuous innovation and growth that constantly looks ahead.

Welcome to Turtle Beach, where our sole mission is to turn gamers into winners—at every level, in every game. We dedicate all our energy to optimizing your gaming experience. In 2005, Turtle Beach pioneered high-quality gaming audio with the very first console gaming headset, the X51. Since then, our uncompromising commitment to quality has been a hallmark of every Turtle Beach gaming accessory—from cross-platform headsets, game controllers, PC keyboards and mice to flight and racing simulators, and more.

Xiaomi is a global consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones, smart hardware and smart electric vehicles connected by its IoT platform at its core. Guided by its mission to let everyone in the world enjoy a better life through innovative technology, Xiaomi is committed to continuous innovation and high-quality user experiences. Xiaomi is one of the world's leading smartphone companies and has established a world-leading consumer AIoT (AI + IoT) platform. Its "Human × Car × Home" smart ecosystem brings together personal devices, smart home products and smart vehicles, creating more intuitive, seamless and intelligent experiences across everyday life. Xiaomi's products and services are available in more than 100 countries and regions worldwide, and in 2026, Xiaomi ranked No. 232 on the Fortune Global 500, marking its eighth consecutive year on the list.

Miele gilt als weltweit führender Anbieter von Premium-Hausgeräten, mit einem begeisternden Portfolio für die Küche, Wäsche- und Bodenpflege. Hinzu kommen Maschinen, Anlagen und Services für den Einsatz etwa in Hotels, Büros oder Pflegeeinrichtungen sowie in der Medizintechnik. Seit seiner Gründung im Jahr 1899 folgt Miele seinem Markenversprechen „Immer Besser“, bezogen auf Qualität, Innovativität, Performance und zeitlose Eleganz. Mit seinen langlebigen und energiesparenden Geräten unterstützt Miele seine Kundinnen und Kunden darin, ihren Alltag möglichst nachhaltig zu gestalten. Das Unternehmen befindet sich weiterhin in der Hand der beiden Gründerfamilien Miele und Zinkann und unterhält 15 Produktionsstandorte, davon acht in Deutschland. Weltweit arbeiten etwa 22.700 Menschen für Miele; der Umsatz betrug zuletzt 4,96 Mrd. Euro. Hauptsitz ist Gütersloh in Westfalen. Miele is recognised as the world's leading supplier of Premium domestic appliances, with an inspiring portfolio for the kitchen, laundry and floor care. The company also offers machines, systems and services for use in hotels, offices, care and medical technology. Since its foundation in 1899, Miele has lived up to its brand promise of "Immer Besser"in terms of quality, innovation, performance and timeless elegance. With its durable and energy-saving appliances, Miele helps its customers to make their everyday lives as sustainable as possible. The company is still owned by the two founding families Miele and Zinkann and has 15 production plants, eight of which are in Germany. Around 22,700 people work for Miele worldwide and the company's most recent turnover was 4,96 billion Euro. The company has its headquarters in Gütersloh in Westphalia.

Beurer is a leading provider of innovative small domestic appliances for everyday use. Since its founding in 1919 and the production of its first heating pad, the product range has expanded to include numerous categories. Today, the portfolio comprises more than 500 products across the areas of health, wellbeing, beauty, personal care, home, fitness, baby, and pet care. Beurer employs 1,800 people worldwide and distributes its products in over 100 countries.

Efficiency in B2B2C – a 25-year success story: over 2,000 stands to date speak for themselves – networking and business guaranteed... The IFA Berlin Reseller Park is an integral part of the leading trade fair for consumer electronics. It has grown steadily over the years and currently hosts over 200 exhibitors. Together with our diverse channel promotion campaigns (e.g. advertising your products and/or offers in SUPERRESELLER) in the run-up to the trade fair, these reliably generate a high ‘pull of trade visitors’. In addition to the new sustainability topics in the Reseller Park (refurbishing!), mobile, IT, CE and home applications include distribution and retail; providers of smart home solutions are also among the green tech solutions, as they typically help to reduce CO2 emissions by 15-30%. The IFA Berlin Reseller Park is therefore a central platform for players in the consumer electronics sector who value sustainability (from catering to floor coverings), innovative distribution solutions and exchange within the industry. With its comprehensive range of exhibition space and services, it offers ideal conditions for companies to present their products and solutions to a wide audience and make new business contacts.

About Panasonic TV Rooted in Japanese craftsmanship and precision engineering, Panasonic TV continues to set the standard for picture and sound quality, stronger and more focused than ever. Built on a continuous pursuit of true-to-life picture quality, professional-grade color accuracy, and immersive sound. Panasonic TVs are engineered in close collaboration with Hollywood colorists and cinema professionals, bringing studio-calibrated imaging into the living room. With a lineup spanning OLED and premium LED technologies, and features designed for both movie lovers and gamers, Panasonic continues to push the category forward, combining craftsmanship, innovation, and picture performance that sets the benchmark for the industry.

eBay at IFA 2026 – Where Live Shopping Meets the Refurbished Revolution. From September 4–8, visitors will find eBay in Hall 20 with an immersive 320 sqm booth featuring interconnected experience zones: 🎤 RE:CONNECT – eBay Live Stage: Real-time live shopping with top brands and sellers. Exclusive deals, interactive giveaways, and the future of commerce – live. ☕ RE:FRESH – Hospitality Zone: Recharge with Kaffee, Slush and a relaxed lounge area. 🔧 RE:USE: Upgrade and extend the lifespan of products – for a more sustainable future. Hall 20 · IFA Berlin · September 4–8, 2026

AliExpress is a premier global retail marketplace owned by the Alibaba Group, serving millions of international shoppers across more than 200 countries and regions. By connecting consumers directly with leading manufacturers and suppliers, the platform provides access to an unparalleled catalog of over 100 million value-driven products spanning consumer electronics, fashion, home goods, and cutting-edge tech innovation.

For over 100 years, beyerdynamic has been shaping sound for people who love technology and embrace a lifestyle-oriented approach. Founded in 1924 by Eugen Beyer, the brand stands for innovation, design, and a captivating audio experience. Combining German design with international manufacturing, beyerdynamic bridges the gap between tradition and the future. Its vision is to develop smart, durable audio products that elevate music, gaming, streaming, and everyday life to a new level—for those who want to hear today what is possible tomorrow.

Every ingenious Russell Hobbs creation is here to help you do you. That's because we're inspired by the things that matter to you. Just-in-time brews. Tackling creases on your own terms. Giving new recipes a go. We get what's important, especially when life's hectic and, let's face it, far from perfect. That's why our ideas are beautifully British and ready for living.

Roku is America's #1 TV streaming platform* and the delightfully simple way to TV, licensing the Roku operating system to leading TV brands and offering its own streaming players, TVs, and smart home devices to hundreds of millions of TV lovers worldwide. *Based on hours streamed—Hypothesis Group

The Volkswagen Passenger Cars brand has a global presence and produces vehicles at 28 locations in twelve countries. In 2025, Volkswagen delivered over 4.7 million vehicles. These include bestsellers such as the Polo, T-Roc, T-Cross, Golf, Tiguan and Passat as well as the successful all-electric models of the ID. family. Last year, the company handed over around 382,000 pure electric vehicles to customers worldwide. Currently, around 170,000 people work at Volkswagen worldwide. With its "BOOST 2030" strategy, Volkswagen is consistently driving forward its further development into the most desirable brand for sustainable mobility.

It all began with a spark and an inventor in Stuttgart. In 1928, when the world was in upheaval, a man with a head full of ideas sat in his small workshop: Dipl.-Ing. Gustav Rommelsbacher. What drove him? More than technology, it was curiosity, a feeling for what has to come. He developed his frist loudspeaker systems in Stuttgart - not just appliances, but sonorous visions of their time. Then came the war. And after that a new beginning . Gustav Rommelsbacher settled in Dinkelsbühl - with nothing but expertise, passion and the will to make thins possible. In a simple garage, he built appliances from whatever he could find that were urgently needed at the time - radiant heaters, irons, mobile hotplates. The 'robusta' brand was born and with it a name that soon came to stand for reliability far beyong Germany. From the garage to the world. The first company building was constructed from solid quarry stome, as durable as the values it carried. Year after year, the company expanded, thought further, built further. A vision became a company. And a garage became a story that continues to this day.

profile_description: EURONICS Deutschland eG, headquartered in Ditzingen near Stuttgart, was founded in 2004 and looks back on a long tradition. The cooperative has more than 1,000 members across over 1,200 locations in Germany. EURONICS Deutschland eG is a partner of the European purchasing and marketing network EURONICS International, based in Amsterdam. With more than 8,500 outlets across 35 European countries, EURONICS is the largest retail group in the sector in Europe. UHD, smart wearables, smart home solutions and household appliances with the highest energy efficiency are just as much a part of the range offered by EURONICS retailers as traditional consumer electronics products. A comprehensive range of services, personalised advice and qualified specialist staff are the common hallmarks of these mostly owner-managed, medium-sized specialist shops and retail outlets. The retail group emerged from the joint venture R.I.C. GmbH, which was founded in 2001 from the merger of the two specialist retail cooperatives Interfunk eG, Ditzingen, and Ruefach GmbH & Co. KG, Ulm. By combining purchasing power with tried-and-tested service models, consistent communication and the introduction of a unified retailer brand, synergy effects have been realised that greatly benefit both the individual members and their customers. In the mass market for consumer electronics, large chain stores and discounters have increasingly contributed to structural change in the past. Small and medium-sized retailers have had to adapt to the advertising and purchasing power of these competitors. As members of a specialist retail cooperative, these businesses are able to offset the disadvantages associated with their size. Under the brand slogan ‘For my best home in the world’, the company not only creates a unified umbrella for marketing and communication that focuses on customers’ homes, but also highlights EURONICS’ core competence beyond its comprehensive online offering: the best in-store service, which makes customers’ personal living spaces simpler, more comfortable and more liveable, and through which the multi-channel retailer clearly sets itself apart from competitors and purely online players.

Starke Funktionen, ästhetische Formen & einfach gute Ideen CASO Design ist eine der ersten Marken, die mit mobilen Küchengeräten die Verschmelzung der Küche mit den alltäglichen Lebensräumen thematisierte. Seit 2003 entwickelt und vertreibt das Familienunternehmen CASO GmbH mit der Marke CASO Design innovative und intelligente Küchentechnik. Von Beginn an haben die Gründer Peter und Bernd Braukmann aus dem sauerländischen Arnsberg die Grundidee mobiler Küchengeräte stetig weiterentwickelt und es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Produkte zu entwerfen, die mehr Bedienkomfort und Leistung bieten: durch starke Funktionen, ästhetische Formen und einfach gute Ideen. Vom Sauerland in die ganze Welt Das Herz von CASO Design schlägt im Sauerland, hier arbeiten rund 110 Mitarbeiter an mehreren Standorten. Von hier aus exportiert CASO heute in rund 30 Länder weltweit, u.a. nach Vietnam und Korea, Dubai, Ägypten, Israel und Skandinavien, in die Türkei, UK und die USA. Ob Europa, Asien, Amerika oder Afrika - der wachsende Export ist auch ein Zeichen der hohen Akzeptanz der Marke in anderen Ländern und Kulturkreisen. Im Fokus stehen Lifestyle-Produkte für Genießer, die hochwertige Lebensmittel maximal lecker zubereiten wollen. Über 20 Jahre CASO Alles begann mit einer Partypfanne, der Durchbruch kam mit mobilen Induktionskochfeldern und Design-Mikrowellen. Heute bietet CASO Design ein breit gefächertes Sortiment mit mehr als 200 hochwertigen Produkten an, sowohl für den Privathaushalt als auch für die Gastronomie. Dazu gehören unter anderem hochwertige Geräte für alle Garmethoden - z.B. modernes Kochen mit Induktion, Braten, Backen, Grillen, Dampfgaren oder Sous-Vide-Garen - mit denen jede(r) optimale Ergebnisse für höchsten Genuss erreichen kann. Für noch mehr Bedienkomfort bietet CASO kostenlose Apps an, mit denen verschiedene Geräte praktisch von überall gesteuert werden können. In den Produktgruppen mobile Induktionskochfelder, Vakuumiersysteme und Weintemperierer nimmt CASO Design bereits seit einigen Jahren eine marktführende Position ein. Zusätzlich verstärkt CASO Design sein Sortiment um Produktbereiche wie Kaffeezubereitung sowie thermische und motorische Küchengeräte.

Founded in 1976, Acer is one of the world’s top technology companies with a presence in more than 160 countries. The company continues to evolve by embracing innovation across its offerings, which include computers and displays, while branching out to new businesses. Acer is also committed to sustainable growth, exploring new opportunities that align with its environmental and social responsibilities. The Acer Group employs nearly 12,000 employees that contribute to the research, design, marketing, sales and support of products, solutions, and services that break barriers between people and technology. Visit www.acer.com for more information.

Metz: Quality Made in Germany It was a forward-thinking young engineer, full of ideas and entrepreneurial spirit, who laid the foundation for a remarkable business success story on 28 November 1938: Paul Metz. From manufacturing radios and developing camera flashes to producing televisions, Metz has continuously expanded and evolved its brand. Today, Metz Consumer Electronics, based in the Nuremberg metropolitan region, is one of Germany’s most established consumer electronics companies. Our focus remains firmly on outstanding quality down to the finest detail, exceptionally long-lasting and repairable televisions, and excellent customer service. Numerous awards demonstrate that, even after more than 85 years, we continue to take our commitment to quality very seriously. To meet the diverse needs of specialist retailers and customers, Metz has successfully pursued a two-brand strategy since 2018. Metz Classic stands for premium televisions “Made in Germany”, combining brilliant picture quality, impressive sound and sophisticated technology for an outstanding viewing experience. METZ blue offers modern smart TVs at more accessible price points, while maintaining a high standard of quality. Together with our specialist retail partners, Metz provides excellent all-round solutions for a worry-free TV experience.

FRITZ! is one of the leaders in Europe when it comes to broadband internet and digital home solutions. FRITZ! products are very easy to use and stand for innovation and versatility: Whether it's fast internet access, easy networking, powerful Wi-Fi, convenient telephony or clever smart home applications — FRITZ! connects you simply and reliably. The FRITZ!OS software regularly offers new features and keeps all products up-to-date and secure for many years. Behind FRITZ! products stands the manufacturer FRITZ! (formerly AVM), which has been developing all products at its Berlin location and producing them in Europe since 1986. In 2025, the company had 925 employees and generated a turnover of 630 million euros.

Founded in 2017, Dreame Technology is a global leader in high-end consumer electronics and intelligent manufacturing. The company specializes in high-speed digital motors, advanced algorithms, and motion control technologies that power its innovative products. Committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology to enhance daily life, Dreame offers a range of smart home cleaning products, including robotic vacuums, robotic lawnmowers, wet and dry vacuums, cordless stick vacuums, and high-speed hair dryers. These products help millions of users save time and improve their quality of life. Innovation lies at the heart of Dreame. Since 2015, its founding team has pioneered high-speed digital motors and intelligent algorithms, providing a unique technological edge. Dreame holds over 6,300 patents worldwide, underscoring its commitment to technology leadership. By collaborating with top design institutes, Dreame combines advanced technology with user-friendly design to create products that seamlessly integrate into everyday life. Trusted by more than 30 million households across over 100 countries, Dreame operates over 6,000 physical stores and serves over 11 million customers worldwide.

NIVONA is different. Open. Friendly. And consistently passionate about coffee in all its forms. The Nuremberg-based company specialises in fully automatic coffee machines. The products impress with their ease of use, convenient cleaning, removable brewing unit and sophisticated aroma technology. With the new 7000 series, NIVONA once again demonstrates how innovation makes a difference in everyday life: a new touchscreen display, a new design and NIVONA’s most advanced brewing unit. In addition, the 8000 series now delivers Nitro coffee into your cup at the touch of a button: smooth, creamy and made for special moments of indulgence in the comfort of your own home. It’s never been easier. Available not only in Germany, but also in Austria, the Netherlands, Poland, France, Estonia and many other countries.

The name Bosch is a worldwide symbol of excellent quality and reliability. For over 90 years, Bosch's home appliances have upheld this reputation, making Bosch Europe’s leading home appliance brand. Its products are based on the real needs of modern households. Thanks to innovative technology and intuitive solutions, Bosch appliances deliver perfect results and simplify everyday life. Robust, precisely finished materials ensure noticeable quality and sustainability. Recognized high service quality cements user trust in the brand and upholds the Bosch guiding principle, “invented for life.” Robert Bosch (1861–1942) founded the company in Germany, in 1886 as the “Workshop for Precision Mechanics and Electrical Engineering.” Since 1967, its home appliance division has been part of BSH Home Appliances Group, a global leader in home appliances with over 56,000 employees and 37 factories in approximately 50 countries.

Sharp Corporation has been a contributor to the development of electronics for more than 110 years. Based on the spirit of its founder “Make products that other companies want to imitate” the company is driven to continually develop innovative products and core technologies. Following the policy of an ESG (Environment, Society, Governance) management strategy, Sharp focuses on "Strengthening the technological capabilities,""Fostering a global mindset,"and "Pursuing management that makes the most of our people". This underlines Sharp's intention to realize innovations unique to the company in numerous fields, including people's lifestyles and work styles by developing innovative technologies and devices. This will ensure that Sharp is always there for people and society and achieves recognition as a company with a strong brand that continuously provides new value.

profile_description: Midea Group is a global technology leader specializing in five key business areas: Smart Home, HVAC and Building Technologies, Robotics and Automation, Electro-Mechanical, and Digital Innovation. As one of over 10 brands within Midea Group's smart home appliance business, Midea has established itself as a prominent force in the industry. Founded in 1968, Midea Group is ranked #277 on the 2024 Fortune Global 500 with 190,000+ employees worldwide. Midea Group established 33 R&D centers and 43 major production sites globally, serving over 500 million users across more than 200 countries. From 2021 to 2023, Midea's total R&D investment exceeded $5.4 billion, underscoring the company's commitment to continuous innovation and excellence in home appliance technology. Guided by its vision of "Bringing Great Innovations to Life,"Midea Group continues to strengthen its leadership in the fields of Smart Home and Smart Manufacturing, maintaining its unwavering commitment to quality and technological advancement.

Sandisk (Nasdaq: SNDK) delivers innovative Flash solutions and advanced memory technologies that meet people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward.

The first SEBO was developed in 1978 to meet the high standards of professionals. In a very short time, SEBO Stein & Co. of Velbert, Germany, became the global market leader in high-quality brush vacuum cleaners for commercial use. SEBO stands for technical innovation and intelligent, detailed solutions. The high-quality appliances are largely developed and manufactured at the company’s headquarters in Velbert. Over 7,000,000 vacuum cleaners sold are a testament to SEBO’s excellent performance. Today, SEBO vacuum cleaners are at home on the red carpet and on gleaming hardwood floors. They are used at the White House in Washington, at Buckingham Palace in London, at the German Bundestag in Berlin, and in leading hotels around the world—from Tokyo, Cape Town, and Paris to Las Vegas and Singapore.

Die Liebherr-Hausgeräte GmbH ist seit sieben Jahrzehnten Spezialist für die Herstellung innovativer Kühl- und Gefriergeräte. Das Unternehmen beschäftigt weltweit mehr als 6.000 Beschäftigte, die ein breites Sortiment an Kühl- und Gefriergeräte für die private und gewerbliche Nutzung entwickeln und produzieren. Dank Frischetechnologien und hochwertigen Materialien beeindrucken die Geräte des Premiumherstellers im Haushalt mit Energieeffizienz, elegantem Design und langer Lebensdauer. Im professionellen Einsatz stehen die Kühl- und Gefriergeräte von Liebherr für absolute Zuverlässigkeit durch intelligente Ausstattungen und einzigartige Qualität. Mit einer Jahresproduktion von rund 2,3 Millionen Geräten gehört Liebherr-Hausgeräte zu den führenden europäischen Premiumanbietern, dessen Produkte Qualität, Design und Innovation vereinen For seven decades Liebherr-Hausgeraete GmbH has been specialising in the manufacture of innovative refrigerators and freezers. The company employs more than 6,000 staff worldwide and develops and produces a wide range of refrigerators and freezers for domestic and professional use. Thanks to their freshness technologies and high-quality materials, the consumer appliances of the premium manufacturer impress with their energy efficiency, elegant design and long service life. In professional use, refrigerators and freezers from Liebherr stand for maximum safety with intelligent features and exceptional quality. With an annual production of around 2.3 million appliances, Liebherr-Hausgeraete is one of the leading European manufacturers in the premium class and combining quality, design and innovation.

Siemens is Europe's leading supplier of built-in home appliances and has been setting global standards in technology, innovation and design for more than 175 years. Its range of home appliances includes built-in appliances and selected free-standing appliances for cooking, cooling, coffee preparation, dish and laundry care. With their distinctive, internationally acclaimed design, home appliances from Siemens stand for intelligence and progressiveness, as well as technology that helps consumers pursue their ambitions. Intelligent solutions, including AI, are at the heart of the Siemens brand and enable customisation, automation and integrated system solutions, always with the aim of creating real added value for consumers. Since 1967 Siemens Home Appliances has been part of BSH Home Appliances Group, a global leader in the home appliances industry with more than 56,000 employees and 37 factories in around 50 countries. The BSH Group is a Trademark Licensee of Siemens AG.

STRONG : Reliable technology for connected living For 40 years, STRONG has been making everyday technology easier to access, use and enjoy. Founded in 1986, STRONG has grown in the European consumer electronics market with a clear focus on practical, reliable and accessible products. The brand has always been close to everyday users, developing solutions that respond to real needs: watching television, accessing digital content, improving home connectivity, extending Wi-Fi coverage, receiving TV signals or staying connected on the move. Over the years, STRONG has built a broad product portfolio across home entertainment, TV reception and connectivity. Its range includes Google TV streaming devices, projectors, receivers, routers, Wi-Fi systems, powerline solutions, switches, mobile broadband devices and accessories. Rather than focusing only on technology for its own sake, STRONG develops products designed to be easy to install, simple to use and useful in everyday environments. At IFA 2026, STRONG will present its latest entertainment and network solutions. Visitors will be able to discover products designed for modern digital lifestyles, from smart viewing and big-screen entertainment to home Wi-Fi, mobile connectivity, multi-floor coverage and wired network expansion. The brand’s approach remains consistent across its different product ranges: making connected technology more understandable, more reliable and easier to integrate into daily life. Whether used at home, at work or on the move, STRONG products are designed to help people stay connected and enjoy digital services with less complexity. At IFA 2026, EKLEER returns to Berlin following its participation in IFA 2025, presenting an expanded portfolio built around one clear philosophy: different markets need different display solutions. Turning Smartphones into Workstations Across the Global South, hundreds of millions of people live in a mobile-only digital environment. Smartphones are widely available, yet access to PCs, broadband infrastructure and productive digital tools remains limited. EKLEER addresses this gap with its Smart Display, designed to transform an Android smartphone into an affordable desktop-style workstation. By connecting a smartphone to a large display with keyboard and mouse support, users can move beyond the limitations of a small screen and gain a practical environment for Digital Work, education and telehealth — using the device they already own. Rather than introducing another expensive computing device, EKLEER adds a productivity layer to the existing mobile ecosystem. Combined with the AI-powered MOVVI platform, including multilingual voice guidance and user support, the solution is designed to make digital productivity more accessible to households and first-time users across emerging markets. This approach was recognized with a CES 2025 Innovation Award. Premium OLED for Creative Professionals At IFA 2026, EKLEER is also introducing its new 16-inch QHD OLED Portable Display, expanding the company's expertise into the premium professional market. Designed for graphic designers, photographers, video creators and mobile professionals, the new display takes full advantage of OLED technology to deliver vivid colors, true blacks, exceptional contrast and highly detailed visual performance in a portable form factor. Its refined industrial design, already protected through registered design rights in Europe, combines visual performance with the aesthetics expected by premium professional users. The result is a display designed not simply as a second screen, but as a professional visual workspace that can travel anywhere. One Display Specialist. Different Markets. Optimized Solutions. EKLEER does not believe in a one-size-fits-all approach. In emerging markets, the challenge is access and affordability. EKLEER's Smart Display helps turn the smartphone — already the primary digital device — into a practical productivity platform. In Europe and other advanced markets, professional users demand mobility, image quality and sophisticated design. EKLEER's premium OLED portfolio is engineered around those priorities. Two different markets. Two different needs. One core expertise: display innovation. With decades of experience in the global IT, consumer electronics and display industries, EKLEER's leadership team combines product development expertise with extensive international business experience. Through its global market-validation journey across CES, MWC, GITEX Africa, GITEX North Star and IFA, EKLEER has continuously refined its products and market strategy while building relationships with telecom operators, distributors, technology partners and international organizations. IFA 2026 represents the next step in that journey — particularly the company's continued expansion into the European market. Meet EKLEER at IFA 2026 Discover how EKLEER is rethinking the role of displays — from enabling digital productivity for mobile-only users to delivering premium OLED experiences for creative professionals. PURE Electric – Designed for a Better Way to Move PURE Electric is a British electric mobility company on a mission to change the way people move through cities. Founded in 2018 by entrepreneur Adam Norris, the company develops innovative e-scooters that combine distinctive design, intelligent engineering and an uncompromising focus on rider safety. Since its launch, PURE Electric has grown from an ambitious British start-up into an internationally established mobility brand. Today, PURE is active in more than 17 countries and has sold over 350,000+ e-scooters worldwide. The idea behind PURE Electric began with a simple question: why should people have to accept compromises when choosing an e-scooter? Too many products were difficult to control, uncomfortable to ride or designed around technical specifications rather than the needs of the rider. Adam Norris believed that electric scooters could be safer, more intuitive and more enjoyable, while at the same time providing a practical alternative for everyday journeys. This belief continues to shape the company’s approach to product development. PURE’s vision is to help create cities in which short journeys are cleaner, smarter and more efficient. Urbanisation, increasing congestion and the need to reduce transport-related emissions are changing the way people think about mobility. E-scooters can play an important role in that transformation, particularly for short urban journeys and the first or last mile of a longer trip. PURE Electric wants to make this form of mobility accessible to a broad international audience without losing sight of quality, safety or design. Every PURE e-scooter is designed and engineered in the United Kingdom. The company’s product development teams concentrate on the aspects that make a genuine difference in everyday use: stability, control, comfort, durability, portability and ease of ownership. Instead of treating the e-scooter as a scaled-down version of another vehicle, PURE develops each model around the specific requirements of the rider and the realities of modern urban travel. Safety is central to this philosophy. PURE challenges conventional e-scooter design and has developed several patented technologies aimed at improving the relationship between rider and vehicle. Selected models feature PURE’s distinctive forward-facing riding position, allowing riders to stand with their feet placed in parallel on either side of the frame. This creates a more natural stance, helps distribute weight more evenly and gives the rider a greater sense of stability and control. The design also allows the rider to look ahead comfortably and respond more confidently to the surrounding environment. The objective is not to add technology simply for the sake of it, but to solve the issues riders encounter in real life: uneven surfaces, changing weather, frequent stopping, limited storage space and the need to feel secure from the first journey onwards. PURE Electric offers a broad portfolio of e-scooters for different lifestyles, expectations and budgets. Although PURE is positioned as a premium mobility brand, premium does not mean limited to a single price category. The range has been developed to make PURE’s design and engineering accessible across the most relevant consumer segments. From straightforward models for daily commuting to high-performance scooters with extended range, advanced suspension and removable batteries, customers can choose the product that best suits the way they travel. The PURE Air range brings together robust everyday usability and contemporary British design. Depending on the model, features include suspension, powerful drive systems, water resistance and carefully tuned ride characteristics. The PURE Escape range takes comfort and capability further, with models designed for riders who expect longer range, greater performance and additional flexibility. Removable battery concepts on selected products make charging and ownership more convenient, particularly for people living in apartments or using their scooter intensively. PURE Flex demonstrates how practical electric mobility can also be remarkably compact. Its innovative folding construction has been designed for situations in which space is at a premium. The scooter can be stored at home, placed in a car or combined with other forms of transport more easily than a conventional full-size model. This makes it especially relevant for urban consumers who want the freedom of individual mobility without allowing the vehicle to dominate their living or storage space. Design plays an important role throughout the PURE range. Clean lines, confident proportions and intelligently integrated components give the products a distinctive appearance without compromising usability. Controls are intended to be clear and intuitive, while displays provide the information riders need without unnecessary distraction. Materials and construction are selected with daily use in mind, helping the scooters retain their quality and character beyond the initial purchase. More than 350,000+ PURE e-scooters have now been sold worldwide. This milestone represents more than commercial growth: it shows that increasing numbers of consumers are choosing e-scooters as a credible part of their everyday mobility. PURE is now present in over 17 countries and continues to expand through retail, distribution and service partnerships. These partnerships allow customers to discover PURE products through trusted local channels while supporting the level of advice and after-sales care expected from a premium brand. Retail remains an essential part of PURE Electric’s growth strategy. An e-scooter is a product that many consumers want to see, understand and experience before making a decision. Strong retail partners can explain differences in riding position, comfort, range and performance, helping customers choose the right model for their individual needs. PURE therefore works closely with its partners on product training, merchandising, marketing and long-term category development. This is particularly important as micromobility develops into a global megatrend. Consumers are increasingly looking for flexible alternatives for short journeys, while cities and governments are searching for ways to reduce congestion and improve the efficiency of urban transport. The e-scooter category is moving beyond its early phase and becoming an established part of the wider consumer electronics and mobility landscape. Customers now expect better design, improved safety, dependable quality and products that fit naturally into their daily lives. PURE Electric believes that the next stage of the market will be defined by meaningful innovation and responsible growth. Every trip completed on an appropriately used e-scooter has the potential to contribute to a more flexible and less carbon-intensive transport system. This is how PURE supports the broader ambition of helping to decarbonise the planet: through practical products that people genuinely want to use. At IFA 2026 in Berlin, PURE Electric will present its current portfolio and the latest developments in its product range. Visitors will be able to experience the diversity of the PURE line-up, explore the thinking behind its British engineering and discover how the company is addressing the changing expectations of consumers and retail partners. The presentation will cover solutions for different price points and use cases, from accessible everyday mobility to premium models featuring advanced comfort, performance and portability. IFA also provides an opportunity for PURE to share its international growth plans and meet the retailers, distributors and industry partners who are helping to shape the future of the category. As demand for high-quality e-scooters continues to grow, PURE is investing in stronger local partnerships, wider availability and a consistent consumer experience across its markets. PURE Electric’s ambition is clear: to create e-scooters that people feel confident riding, enjoy owning and want to make part of their daily routine. With British design and engineering, several patented technologies, a portfolio covering the most relevant consumer needs and more than 350,000 scooters already sold worldwide, PURE is helping to define the next generation of personal electric mobility. The ride is everything. Visit PURE Electric at IFA 2026 in Hall 4.2, Stand 130.

OOLU Soft is a Seoul-based AI video analytics company. Our product, MotionCat , turns existing CCTV cameras into an AI safety control room — without camera replacements and without expensive GPU servers. Most industrial sites have cameras, but no one watching them when accidents happen. MotionCat reads RTSP streams 24/7 to detect fire, intrusion, falls, and hazards, alerting staff only when it matters. Key features: - 3-Stage Triage Architecture: Filters traffic down to ~1% for AI natural-language analysis. - Extreme Efficiency: A 10-year-old PC (8 GB RAM) runs 5–6 channels locally (50–100 ms) fully offline. - Privacy by Design: Raw video stays on-site. Optional KNT (Keyed Nonlinear Transformation) prevents image reconstruction on feature maps. Proven across Korean industrial sites (logistics, plants, intersections), commercially launched in August 2026, and expanding globally starting with Japan’s OPEN Group.

Every year, AI gets more powerful — and more demanding. But the chip inside a car, an appliance, or a robot stays small. The result: the smartest AI can’t actually run where people need it. It gets stranded in the cloud — slow, dependent on a connection, and out of reach. Nota AI changes that. Our platform, NetsPresso ® , shrinks AI models to run directly on the device’s own chip — instantly, privately, and even with no internet at all. The intelligence lives inside the product itself. Nothing makes this harder than Physical AI — the appliances, humanoids, and robots now coming to life. A robot needs a massive brain to see, understand, and act in the real world, yet it has to fit inside a small, moving body running on a tiny chip. NetsPresso compresses that robot brain to fit — and proves it works on the real hardware. That experience is already trusted by 102+ partners, including NVIDIA, Arm, Qualcomm, and Samsung. Physical AI is where we take it next. Nota AI GmbH is based here in Berlin. Come talk to us about bringing powerful AI into your device — and into Physical AI.

The Open Home Foundation was created in 2024 with one clear mission: to fight for the rights of people living in smart homes. We envision an open source alternative to Big Tech control: the Open Home, where the principles of privacy, choice, and sustainability are guaranteed. As a Swiss non-profit organisation, we protect our projects – including the Home Assistant open source smart home platform – from corporate takeover, so we can focus resources on developing open standards and solutions for our users and community. It also means we’re free to advocate for ethical technology: educating the wider public and holding brands to the highest of standards. Together, we’re working to make our Open Home vision a reality. For IFA-related inquiries, please send an email to ifa@openhomefoundation.org.

Tucano is a leading Italian manufacturer of bags, backpacks, and covers for electronic devices. The company is active in the business, travel, and leisure markets. Founded in Milan in 1985, thanks to the entrepreneurial intuition of Franco Luini, its founder and CEO, Tucano was born together with the computer market, producing the first computer carrying cases in the late 80s. In a practically untouched market, Tucano launched a variety of solutions for the first compact PC in history, the legendary Apple Macintosh Plus designed by Steve Jobs and presented to the public in 1986. Tucano has continued to keep pace with Apple's innovative product lines, designing bags, backpacks and covers for the computer company's most revolutionary products: the MacBook, the iPhone and the iPad. Tucano's PC bags were ahead of their time in a world where personal computers would soon revolutionize everyday life. In the 1990s, with the marketing of the first laptops, Tucano created Computer Comforts, the first complete range of high-tech, black computer bags specifically designed to carry and protect them. Since personal computers came equipped with a mouse, Tucano was the first Italian company to focus on the mousepad. Colorful and fun, mousepads became increasingly popular and made Tucano a household name. The Milan-based company continues to focus on this market, investing in research and development and the production of innovative and "smart"products designed for a customer base of digital-natives. In a short time, in addition to protection, the company also focused on color, offering new collections that revolutionized the concept of high-tech computer bags and achieved unexpected results. Design, careful choices in terms of the materials used and the adoption of sophisticated accents have generated exclusive and iconic products that brought the brand international recognition: the Second Skin® and the Work Out bag unequivocally express the spirit of this trend-setting design. Since 2017, Tucano has focused on sustainability and reducing its environmental impact through the adoption of recycled plastic or compostable materials for a substantial portion of its product catalog. These certified materials and accessories are in line with new European regulations. Taking on the challenge of ethical and environmentally-friendly production can play a crucial role in safeguarding the planet and is also part of a larger program. Tucano's focus on social and environmental responsibility is part of a corporate program that envisions a complete transformation, which also extends to the company's internal operations. This commitment has resulted in a series of concrete, green initiatives such as controlled waste management and reduction as well as energy requalification. Tucano has an extensive presence in more than 60 countries, selling approximately 5 million products annually. It's primary target markets are consumers who use Apple, as well as the education, tech, travel and lifestyle channels. In addition to its headquarters in Milan's Piazza Castello, Tucano has four international branches based in New York, Dongguan, Bangalore and Mendrisio. Tucano's products are manufactured in China, where there is a specialized quality-control sector that monitors all stages of the production process.

legal_company_name: Cradle to Cradle - Wiege zur Wiege e.V.
profile_description: Die spendenfinanzierte und gemeinnützige Cradle to Cradle NGO bringt das Kreislaufprinzip Cradle to Cradle (C2C) durch Bildungsformate in die Breite, vernetzt Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft, Bildung, Politik sowie Zivilgesellschaft und setzt wegweisende Transformationsprojekte um, die zeigen, wie viel C2C heute bereits möglich ist. Rund 1.000 ehrenamtlich Aktive im deutschsprachigen Raum tragen den Ansatz in die Welt. Der Internationale Cradle to Cradle Congress, der am 17. und 18. September 2026 zum zehnten Mal stattfindet (TU Berlin), ist die weltweit erste und größte C2C-Plattform: Über 1.000 Teilnehmende treffen hier auf zentrale Persönlichkeiten aus Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft und Politik. 2019 wurde das C2C LAB in Berlin aufgebaut und ab 2025 auf 500 Quadratmeter ausgebaut und um einen Community Hub ergänzt: die weltweit erste umfassende Sanierung einer bestehenden Gewerbeeinheit nach C2C-Kriterien. 2022 und 2024 wurde das Labor Tempelhof umgesetzt: sechs nach C2C optimierte Großkonzerte von Die Ärzte und Die Toten Hosen in Berlin. Alle, die sich für einen positiven ökologischen Fußabdruck engagieren wollen, können bei uns aktiv werden. Auf der IFA steht ein ganz konkreter Schwerpunkt unserer Arbeit im Fokus – die Cradle to Cradle Electronics Initiative: Lösungen für zirkuläre Elektronik nach Cradle to Cradle gibt es längst – sie sind nur verstreut. Die C2C Electronics Initiative bringt zusammen, was zusammengehört: Unternehmen, Zivilgesellschaft und Wissenschaft bilden gemeinsam mit der C2CEI ein lebendiges Wissens- und Praxisnetzwerk. Dieses Netzwerk entwickelt bestehende und neue C2C-Ansätze auf Marktfähigkeit und Skalierbarkeit hin weiter und bringt Elektronikprodukte und Geschäftsmodelle mit positiven ökologischen, ökonomischen und sozialen Auswirkungen in die Praxis. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft der Elektronikbranche.

ToolDance X1 — Desktop CNC Machining Center ToolDance develops intelligent desktop manufacturing systems that make industrial-grade CNC machining accessible to creators, small businesses, and engineers. The ToolDance X1 is our flagship product: a compact CNC machining center that delivers the precision, speed, and automation typically found only in factory-floor equipment — now sized for a workshop, studio, or garage. Industrial Performance, Desktop Footprint At the core of the X1 is a 1500W permanent magnet synchronous spindle running at 24,000 RPM, paired with a rigid cast machine frame engineered for vibration damping and thermal stability. The result is repeatable positioning accuracy at industrial tolerances and surface finishes suitable for end-use parts — not just prototypes. The X1 processes aluminium, brass, steel, titanium, wood, and engineering plastics with equal confidence. Both dry and flood cooling modes are supported. The integrated flood cooling system extends tool life and unlocks harder materials, while dry cutting with the built-in dust collection module keeps the workspace clean for softer materials. Intelligent Automation Through Sensing What separates the X1 from conventional desktop CNCs is its integrated sensing architecture. A dual-sensor system combining RGB imaging and structured light projection performs automatic 3D reconstruction of the workpiece and fixtures. A precision 3D touch probe completes the measurement chain. Together, these systems enable: Automatic workpiece recognition and alignment — no manual measurement required Automatic tool length and diameter verification via RFID-tagged tooling Fixture detection and clamping guidance Real-time collision prediction and avoidance The 9-slot automatic tool changer with RFID identification eliminates manual tool swaps during multi-operation jobs, enabling true unattended machining cycles. Software: ToolDance Studio The X1 ships with ToolDance Studio, a purpose-built CAM environment designed to dramatically lower the programming barrier. Key capabilities include: AI-assisted automatic toolpath generation from imported 3D models Design for Manufacturability (DFM) analysis before cutting begins Physics-based machining simulation that accounts for tool geometry, material properties, and cutting forces Automatic error compensation based on real-time machine and tool condition For experienced users, an expert programming mode provides full manual control over every parameter. Safety and Reliability The X1 incorporates multi-layered safety systems: real-time collision monitoring with automatic emergency stop, tool breakage detection, spindle thermal management, and predictive maintenance alerts for tools, filters, and consumables. An integrated camera enables remote video monitoring of active machining jobs. A Platform, Not Just a Machine The X1 is designed as an expandable platform. Available modules include a 4th axis rotary unit, a full 5-axis expansion kit, and an open tooling ecosystem supporting third-party end mills and holders. An open software ecosystem and content platform connect users to shared projects, toolpaths, and machining strategies. About ToolDance ToolDance is headquartered in Shenzhen, China, with operations serving global markets. The X1 launches via Kickstarter in October 2026.

Memoket is an AI hardware company building the context layer between the physical world and artificial intelligence. Founded by veterans of Anker Innovations, Bosch, Procter & Gamble, and Johnson & Johnson, Memoket is solving one of the most pressing unsolved problems in the AI era: how to give AI tools the context of what actually happens in the real world. AI tools and agents are only as good as the context we feed them. But the context that actually matters, the client call, the negotiation, the team discussion that changed the roadmap, happens in the real world and never makes it into your AI. People spend hours every week briefing their tools from scratch, reconstructing what was said in meetings just so their AI can be useful. Memoket is built to close that gap. Memoket Gem Memoket's first product is Memoket Gem, the world's lightest AI wearable built for context capture. Weighing just 11g, Gem is designed to disappear into the day. Press once to start capturing a conversation. Press once to stop. Everything else is automatic. After capture, Gem does something no other product on the market does: it connects conversations across time. If a topic that came up today was also discussed three weeks ago, Gem surfaces what was said then automatically, with a source link to review the exact moment. Over time, Gem builds a structured, searchable memory of a user's real-world conversations, the context their AI tools have always been missing. The Baton is a music technology company developing digital solutions that make ensemble playing more accessible, flexible, and connected. Traditional ensemble playing requires musicians to find suitable partners, coordinate schedules, and obtain or prepare music for different instruments and skill levels. These practical barriers often make it difficult for people to experience the joy of playing together, even when they are motivated to do so. To address these challenges, The Baton developed Pajama Jam , a social ensemble platform that enables musicians to discover and form teams, access suitable ensemble arrangements, and create performances together regardless of location or schedule. Through AI-powered arrangement technology, adaptive skill-level matching, and a recording-based collaboration system, Pajama Jam allows each player to record their part independently and combine individual performances into an ensemble video. The platform is designed to connect musicians across instruments, generations, countries, and musical genres. By removing the limitations of physical location and synchronized schedules, The Baton aims to expand access to collaborative music-making and create new opportunities for people to connect through music. The Baton has developed proprietary technologies for automated musical arrangement and media processing, secured patents and international trademarks, and established partnerships across the sheet-music, licensing, content, education, and ensemble sectors. Pajama Jam is currently available to players internationally, with a growing community of test users and partners.

■ Collaboration and Desired Partner Types 1. Mobility and Corporate Fleet Management (Fleet & Mobility) Target Companies: Car-sharing services, car rental companies, taxi and transportation/logistics firms, delivery platforms Collaboration Proposals: Enhancing real-time safety monitoring systems for large corporate fleets; minimizing casualties and maximizing vehicle uptime (reducing downtime) through immediate e-Call (emergency rescue) responses in the event of an accident 3. Public Institutions and Smart Cities (B2G & Smart City) Target Organizations: Local governments, fire and police departments, agencies under the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and smart city developers Collaboration Proposal: Integrated implementation of a mobility safety network (e-Call) within local governments; improvement of smart transportation infrastructure through the collection and analysis of traffic safety data, such as from accident-prone areas 4. Aftermarket Distribution and Sales (Distribution & Sales) Target Companies: Online and offline distributors of automotive accessories, automotive tuning and maintenance franchises, e-commerce platforms Collaboration Proposal: Developing sales channels for SafeCar devices targeting general drivers (B2C); signing agreements with sales agents; and planning bundled product packages (including dashcams and other automotive accessories) 5. Technology and Service Platform Integration (Tech & API) Target Companies: Navigation apps, dashcam manufacturers, connected car platforms, healthcare apps Collaboration Proposal: Integration of SafeCar’s AI accident detection algorithm and data API; creation of added value through integration with external services upon collision detection (e.g., real-time sharing of accident locations within navigation apps, guardian notification apps, etc.) ■ Innovation That Captures Every Moment Before and After an Accident SafeCar uses V2D (Vehicle-to-Device) communication to connect vehicles and OBD-II devices in real time. AI continuously analyzes vehicle data to quickly and accurately distinguish between normal driving and critical accident types, such as collisions and sudden acceleration. In particular, in the event of a serious accident, it instantly analyzes critical driving data from 5 seconds before the accident to 1 second after, automatically generating a customized accident report in just 1 second. The generated report complies with GDPR and is promptly delivered to guardians and relevant authorities in accordance with global accident reporting standards, ensuring that the “golden hour” for occupants is preserved.

We can tell a lot about Eurom, but it can also be brief. We have been developing and selling electrical products since 1974. These products are divided into seven main categories: Cleaning Garden & Recreation Terrace heating Permanent heating Heating Climate control Aggregates Mission As a growing organisation we of course have a mission: something we stand for, what we think is important. For Eurom that is “working together for comfort for everyone”. How we do that is explained below. Eurom creates comfort for the consumer by developing climate and seasonal products. Eurom products are distinctive: • Extra safe • Sustainable solutions • Always innovative • User friendly • High quality Eurom creates comfort for the customer by offering products that the consumer likes to visit. We do this with a surprisingly high level of service. Eurom creates comfort for its employees by striving for a pleasant working environment. We work hard, but we do it together. We can count on each other and enjoy our work. We radiate that! Eurom creates comfort for the suppliers by putting the mutual relationship first. Quality and respect are important in which we work together on the Eurom vision. Vision Our mission “working together for comfort for everyone” is how we want to realize our vision. Because we of course want to achieve something. What that is? Eurom wants to make a difference. We do this by continuously developing our products and services. In this way, we want to offer the consumer good products and the customer a more extensive range with an increasingly better one service. Together we work on manageable growth and a better, safer and more sustainable future. History November 1974 marks the beginning of Eurom. Jaap Bakker starts the company Euromac, named after what the company will sell: European Machines. In the starting years these machines were fully tailored towards agrarian life. Professional products that can withstand the tough life in the agricultural sector. Robust, sturdy and with lots of power. Think about high pressure cleaners, heaters and generators. Sound machines that do what is expected, this has been Eurom’s power from the beginning. Changes in the agricultural sector forst Euromac into action. Less farmers meant less demand for the professional products Euromac became big with. But electrical products, that was still in demand. The knowledge Euromac had gained over the years was used to develop products for the regular consumer. The focus still on achieving the best quality. Over the years Euromac developed a broad assortment of products that find their way to the consumer through dealers. The assortment is divided into six categories: cleaning, garden & reacreation, terrace heating, heating, climate control and aggregates. In 2010 Jaap passes on the baton to his son, Wycher Bakker, who becomes director of Euromac. Subsequently Euromac changes it’s name to ‘Eurom’ in 2011. This was done to bring more unity into the company, that already branded it’s products under ‘Eurom’. More unity means more power, and that has been proven. Over the years Eurom grew exponentially. Where the company could fit 100 pallets in storage back in 1974, nowadays this is the impressive number of 10.000 pallets. Of course a lot preceeded this, such as two moves and a number of rebuildings. Eurom has endured a lot of changes, but the service and quality Eurom delivers has remained the same, if not improved. Each year again Eurom strives for better, nicer and smarter products. Eurom does this with a team of involved employees that work hard to support their clients. From production to aftersales, Eurom always offers more! Would you like know even more about Eurom? Contact us.

Reimagining Natural Innovation Through Science Formularium Srl is an Italian innovative startup developing next-generation botanical technologies for the health, beauty and wellness industries. Our mission is to unlock the hidden value of natural resources by transforming agricultural by-products into high-performance bioactive ingredients through proprietary extraction technologies and advanced formulation expertise. We believe that the future of cosmetics, medical devices and nutraceuticals will not be driven by synthetic innovation alone, but by the intelligent combination of biotechnology, sustainability and circular economy. Formularium was created to bridge the gap between scientific research and industrial application. Building on more than eighty years of family experience in pharmacy and over five decades in cosmetic formulation and manufacturing, we combine a strong industrial heritage with the agility and vision of a technology startup. Our focus is the development of innovative natural bioactive ingredients obtained from renewable botanical sources. By applying Ultrasound-Assisted Extraction (UAE), we maximize the recovery of delicate phytocomplexes while preserving their biological activity, reducing energy consumption, minimizing solvent use and creating a significantly more sustainable production process than conventional extraction methods. Rather than manufacturing commodities, Formularium develops intellectual and technological assets that can be translated into multiple commercial applications across different industries. Our platform enables the creation of innovative active ingredients and finished formulations for cosmetics, intimate care, medical devices and nutraceutical products. The scalability of our approach lies in the versatility of our technology. The same extraction platform can generate new functional ingredients from different botanical matrices, opening opportunities for licensing, co-development, private label and proprietary consumer brands. To validate our technology in the marketplace, we recently launched Fermenta Botanica, our first proprietary premium dermocosmetic brand. More than a cosmetic line, it represents a successful proof of concept, demonstrating our ability to transform scientific innovation into products capable of addressing emerging consumer needs with strong market differentiation. Today, Formularium is entering its next stage of growth. Our objective is to expand our technology platform, accelerate research and development, strengthen intellectual property, scale production capabilities and establish strategic international partnerships. At IFA Berlin, we are seeking investors and innovation partners who share our vision of building a new generation of sustainable health and beauty technologies. We are particularly interested in collaborations that can accelerate international growth, industrial scale-up and the commercialization of our proprietary innovations. Formularium is more than a cosmetics company. We are building an environment where biotechnology, circular economy and formulation science converge to create high-value natural innovations with global market potential. Science-driven. Naturally inspired. Built to scale.

Carchain is an AI-powered fleet intelligence and smart logistics platform that helps companies manage vehicles, drivers, assets, tasks and operational flows from one intelligent dashboard. We go beyond traditional GPS tracking by combining IoT telematics, artificial intelligence, OEM connectivity, BLE beacons, driver apps and blockchain-based sustainability tools into a modular SaaS platform. Our goal is to make fleet and logistics operations more proactive, cost-efficient, automated and environmentally responsible. Carchain supports mixed fleets, including connected and non-connected vehicles, ICE, hybrid and electric vehicles. Companies can start with plug-and-play GPS/OBD devices installed in minutes, use native OEM integrations where available, or combine both approaches in the same fleet. This flexibility allows fleet managers to digitize operations without complex installations, workshops or rigid hardware requirements. Our product includes real-time vehicle tracking, trip and stop analysis, driver identification, fuel and energy monitoring, maintenance reminders, document management, cost tracking and total cost of ownership dashboards. Fleet managers can monitor vehicle activity, mileage, expenses, fuel consumption, idle time, driving behavior and maintenance needs in one place, helping them reduce costs, prevent downtime and make better decisions. One of Carchain’s key differentiators is the AI Assistant, designed as a conversational fleet management expert. Instead of manually analyzing spreadsheets or complex dashboards, users can ask questions in natural language about mileage, fuel consumption, maintenance costs, vehicle performance, anomalies, driver activity or operational efficiency. The assistant provides instant insights, helping companies save administrative time and act faster. Carchain also offers predictive maintenance and AI-based diagnostic analysis. By analyzing telematics data, historical maintenance information and vehicle error codes, the platform helps identify anomalies and potential failures before they become expensive breakdowns. This is especially valuable for service companies, construction fleets, HVAC maintenance teams, waste management operators, municipalities and logistics businesses where vehicle downtime directly affects operations. In addition to fleet management, Carchain provides asset and equipment tracking through BLE beacons and sensors. Companies can monitor trailers, tools, containers, machinery, equipment and other mobile assets alongside their vehicles. The platform can show asset location, last update, on-board detection, movement, battery status and asset details, improving traceability and reducing losses. Carchain also includes a Driver App for task management, driver identification, work hours, car sharing, carpooling and operational coordination. The app supports field teams by allowing companies to assign tasks dynamically, manage vehicle usage, collect operational data and maintain visibility even when connectivity is limited, with offline capabilities and automatic syncing. Sustainability is built into the platform through our Green Fleet module. Carchain enables CO2 emissions tracking, ESG-ready reporting and certified carbon offsetting with blockchain-verified records. This helps companies measure their environmental impact, improve fleet efficiency, identify opportunities for electrification and provide transparent sustainability data for internal reporting, clients, tenders and compliance needs. We are also expanding Carchain into smart logistics. For the Central Fruit and Vegetable Market in Guimarães, we are developing a solution to optimize logistics flows, dispatching, vehicle access, traceability and operational efficiency. This project reflects our broader vision: connecting vehicles, assets, tasks and infrastructure into a smarter system that helps local markets, municipalities and logistics operators reduce congestion, improve coordination and make better use of resources. Carchain is designed for companies that need a practical, scalable and cost-effective solution to manage complex operations without replacing their existing systems. Our modular approach allows clients to activate only the features they need and scale over time, from basic real-time monitoring to advanced AI insights, predictive maintenance, smart logistics and sustainability reporting. In short, Carchain is the digital copilot for modern fleets and logistics operations: helping organizations save money, reduce downtime, automate manual work and accelerate the transition toward smarter and greener mobility.

NEXUO is a Predictive Physical AI platform for industrial quality inspection, safety monitoring, and crowd analytics. Built by Next Integral, NEXUO runs entirely on-premise on NVIDIA Jetson edge hardware, with no cloud dependency, no data leaving the site, and no defect catalog required. Instead of training on thousands of labeled defects, NEXUO learns what "normal" looks like from good samples only, then predicts and flags deviations before they become failures or incidents — from production line anomalies to safety and crowd-flow risks in public venues. This "good-samples-only" approach makes NEXUO especially suited to low-volume, high-mix, or safety-critical environments where collecting defect data is slow, costly, or simply impossible. NEXUO is currently deployed across smart-city safety monitoring pilots in Taiwan (Kaohsiung Arena, Songshan Cultural Park) and is being scoped for industrial CNC and manufacturing quality-control use cases with partners in Taiwan and Europe. Next Integral is an NVIDIA Inception member (Top 80, Grand Challenge 2026), with an engineering team combining 15+ years of industrial computer vision experience across aeronautics, medical, and CNC systems.

This outdated method forces them to constantly break their visual focus, shifting their attention away from the marine environment, their dive buddies, and potential hazards just to monitor critical life-support data. We are entirely eliminating this dangerous cognitive and visual blind spot. By seamlessly projecting a high-contrast, crystal-clear, and highly intuitive user interface directly into the diver’s natural field of view, we deliver an unprecedented, true hands-free experience. This breakthrough represents far more than just a convenient, seamless interaction with technology; it is a paradigm shift. Our system provides instant, line-of-sight visual alerts—tracking depth, no-decompression limits, directional navigation, and remaining tank pressure—which fundamentally redefine the boundaries of underwater safety and human performance. Wenn das Finanzamt fragt, zählt nicht Ihre Absicht — sondern Ihr Nachweis. Wer Consumer Electronics, Smartphones oder Komponenten über EU-Grenzen handelt, trägt ein Risiko, das mit korrekten Rechnungen allein nicht beherrschbar ist: den Vorwurf, von einem Umsatzsteuerbetrug an anderer Stelle der Lieferkette gewusst zu haben — oder hätte wissen müssen. Die Folgen treffen das Unternehmen und seine Organe persönlich: Vorsteuerversagung, Haftungsbescheide, Arrest, Ermittlungsverfahren bis hin zur Europäischen Staatsanwaltschaft. Vogel, Sprinke & Kollegen — Steuerberater und Rechtsanwälte aus Viernheim — haben sich auf genau diese Schnittstelle spezialisiert: Umsatzsteuer-Compliance für Handels- und Technologieunternehmen. Wir machen aus Lieferketten Beweisketten. Ein auf die Umsatzsteuer zugeschnittenes Tax Compliance Management System übersetzt Redlichkeit in das, was im Streitfall zählt: beweisbare, dokumentierte, zum Zeitpunkt der Entscheidung entstandene Sorgfalt — von der qualifizierten USt-IdNr.-Prüfung über das Ampel-System zur Lieferantenbewertung bis zum Evidence Pack für den Ernstfall. Und wenn es ernst wird, verteidigen wir: gegen Versagungsbescheide nach § 25f UStG, in Karussell-Verdachtsfällen, bei Durchsuchung, Arrest und EPPO-Verfahren — EU-weit, auf Grundlage einer eigenen Rechtsprechungsdatenbank von Kittel bis zu den jüngsten Entscheidungen aus Luxemburg und München. Ergänzt um den Blick, der oft fehlt: D&O- und Straf-Rechtsschutz-Architektur, damit die Verteidigung finanziert ist, bevor sie gebraucht wird. Besuchen Sie uns: Prüfen Sie Ihr Haus in fünfzehn Minuten mit unserem USt-TCMS Quick Scan — und erfahren Sie im Gespräch, wo Ihre Lieferkette angreifbar ist und wie daraus eine Beweiskette wird. RobotWare.AI is an innovative AgTech pioneer fundamentally transforming the fragile, labor-intensive global poultry industry into a resilient, fully autonomous ecosystem . Our mission is to resolve the catastrophic polycrisis of severe rural labor shortages and the persistent endemic threat of infectious diseases through our world’s first edge-native Physical AI platform, "Robotinside." Unlike traditional passive smart farms limited to basic environmental sensing, RobotWare.AI delivers an overarching active operating system. Our 24/7 autonomous sentinel cohabitates with the flock, representing the ultimate realization of Physical AI. By flawlessly fusing a strategic intelligence "Brain" with an agile robotic "Body," the platform executes complex, hazardous physical interventions autonomously. It eliminates the need for human workers in toxic environments, achieving a 95% success rate in retrieving bio-hazardous objects within 120,000-bird commercial testbeds . Powered by zero-latency on-device edge computing, this Physical AI platform continuously maps its interaction radius via RGB-D sensors to calculate the Dynamic Vitality Index (DVI), while acoustic edge AI tracks the Cough Detection Index (CDI). This multi-modal data fusion proactively predicts illnesses before clinical outbreaks, preventing devastating flock culls and actively combating global antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Furthermore, RobotWare.AI completely democratizes farm management. By integrating an advanced Large Language Model (LLM) conversational agent, we replace complex analytical dashboards with intuitive, natural-language dialogue. We demand zero physical strength or specialized veterinary expertise, empowering marginalized demographics to independently manage highly profitable farms. RobotWare.AI is not just building robots; we are establishing a sustainable Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) to guarantee global food security, animal welfare, and ultimate liberation from agricultural labor.

KAISAR was originally researched for male sexual function in men in their 30s–50s. A single product now addresses both vitality and healthy-aging demand — two segments that scale independently. Defensible IP and a clinical pathway. Patents are granted in Korea, the United States, China, Japan and Europe (including the UK). The mechanism research conducted with university hospital medical staff has been submitted for peer review, and a human application study is currently underway in Korea. This gives KAISAR a credible route from consumer wellness toward clinically supported positioning — while continuing to sell today under consumer electronics rules.
